comment: Read from src/Canyon.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The buffer is 352800 samples (Canyon.cpp:14), which the maker's comment calls about eight seconds; the delay block is stepped every second sample, so the entry states the time as a fraction of the buffer rather than in seconds. Feedback is multiplied by 1.1 before the jack is applied and clamped at 1.1 (Canyon.cpp:342 and 344), so the top of the knob is above unity gain and the lines build rather than decay; nothing on the panel says so. In Light/Dark the filter corner is worked out from the unclamped knob-plus-jack sum and only the crossfade position is clamped (Canyon.cpp:357 to 359), so a large CV can push the corner far outside the 300Hz to 1200Hz the knob alone reaches. The Feedback, Freeze and Reverse controls are marked with glyphs rather than words, as are their jacks, and the four small CV attenuverters have no labels at all. The module has no right-click menu of its own, so no panel-colour choice. There is no manual and no README entry for it.
